changes: Generated with the built-in image tool and saved as concept-2.png in the current directory.
Removed the previous long suspension festoon above the arch, making the orange arch and concrete pylons more prominent; short cable segments remain.
Added setbacks to the fort while preserving its brick arches, open courtyard, flat parapet and lighthouse. The rendered footprint still does not reproduce the supplied map exactly.
Retained recessed anchorage panels and braced approach towers, but the anchorage still appears too tall to satisfy the y14 limit.
